951: Only people born into a good family naturally have these two together: being fair and honest, and feeling shame at doing wrong.
953: A smiling face, giving to others, kind words, and never looking down on anyone: people say these four are the marks of a truly good family.
1009: Shining riches gathered by giving up love, making yourself go without, and ignoring what is right will be taken by others in the end.
1012: Food, clothing and the other needs of life are the same for every living being. What makes humans special is a sense of shame.
1024: For people who work hard without delay to lift up their family, the work gets done by itself, even without careful planning.
1051: If you meet people it is right to ask, you may ask them for help. If they hide what they have and say no, the blame is theirs, not yours.
